Sam forms two different 6-digit numbers, X and Y, using digits from 0 to 9 (without repetition within a number). Exactly two digits are common between X and Y.
• The digit 9 appears in the same position in both numbers
• Y ends with 0, has only one even digit, and its digits are arranged in descending order
• 6 is present in X, and the number of even digits on its left is equal to the number of even digits on its right
If X is the largest possible number, what is the difference between X and Y?
a) 9310
b) 9210
c) 8420
d) 8310
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Starter
decide how to begin
Begin with Y: it has five odd digits and a 0 at the end, in descending order. Write it down.
Slicer
break it into small parts
Now build X one clue at a time: where is the 9, which digits can it share with Y, and where must the 6 go?
YOUR TURN
Write the largest X, then subtract Y.
